title: 仮設トイレキャビン
description: 補強リブのある樹脂外壁、少し開いた扉と使用表示錠、アーチ屋根、通気管、スキッドと簡易内装を備えた仮設トイレ。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A portable toilet cabin with ribbed molded shell, slightly open latched door, occupancy indicator, arched roof, vent stack, skids and modeled seat interior. Static visualization only, not sanitation or accessibility certified. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
